patthana21.45:1.1: na kenaciviññeyyaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kenaciviññeyyo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: .. kenacinaviññeyyo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: .. kenaciviññeyyo sanidassanasappaṭigho ca kenacinaviññeyyo sanidassanasappaṭigho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:
patthana21.45:2.1: tīṇi. na kenacinaviññeyyaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. tīṇiyeva.
patthana21.45:3.1: na kenaciviññeyyaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighañca na kenacinaviññeyyaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca .. tīṇiyeva. sabbattha nava.
patthana21.45:4.1: nakenaciviññeyya naanidassanasappaṭighassa purimasadisaṃ navapañhaṃ kātabbā. nakenaciviññeyya naanidassanaappaṭighamūlassa navapañhameva. noāsavaduka
